metadata.description: Skills for an AI agent to do real company work, one plugin per area of work. The same folders are served live through SkillCDN at skillcdn.ai/gh/skillcdn/skills.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Marketing and growth: ads, ad and product research, promotional video, content, campaigns. A short-form AI ad from a reference video and a product link, and research in the Meta Ad Library for ad creatives and for rising products.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Original video and audio content: scripted short dramas, series episodes and story-driven shorts. One episode of a vertical short drama on Higgsfield from a premise or a series bible, with native dialogue, verified lines and coded subtitles.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Software development and the tooling an agent works with: code, a codebase's documents, apps, testing, debugging. A skill written from work already done with an agent, in a repository of this layout, checked and tried by a fresh agent, and a skill verified again from a fresh session after it changed.
